title: 秋華賞の後に・疼く両脚

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet loses to Vodka in the Shuka Sho. In her frustration, she vows to settle the score.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka challenges her to a rematch at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She accepts and watches Vodka leave, swearing that next time, she'll beat her rival once and for all.
